expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The bottom tab bar renders a thick dark horizontal bar that overlaps and obscures the middle icons (search/bookmark), and the icons are cut off at the bottom of the screen. Tab labels are missing entirely.
The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza image with a −20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or price row, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
In 'Fastest near you' the third card is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol…') and its image is clipped by the viewport edge, with no visible affordance that the row scrolls horizontally.
The category chip row is also clipped at the right edge, with a partially visible chip after 'Healthy' that is unreadable.
The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circle with dark outline heart while the pizza card uses a dark circle with white heart.
Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' and the search placeholder use light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
The promo banner's decorative translucent circles are clipped awkwardly at the card's right edge and the banner's bottom corners appear square while other cards are rounded.

expected.reasoning: Issue 0 directly describes bottom tab bar with overlapping icons, cut-off labels, and the thick dark bar obscuring elements—matching all aspects of the expected defect including the gesture bar overlap.
